title: Foundations: Comedy Songs - The Complete Guide
summary: What Comedy Songs is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Comedy Songs songs: Novelty songs are pop's class clowns: funny voices, silly premises, and hooks that stick like gum. From Spike Jones's sound-effect chaos to Weird Al's parodies, they prove pop can laugh at itself.

History: 1940s Spike Jones, 1950s–60s chart-toppers (The Chipmunks, 1958; Monster Mash, 1962), and 'Weird Al' Yankovic (1980s–present) kept novelty on the charts. Dance crazes are novelty's athletic cousin.

How the songs work: Comedy Songs favors the keys of C, G, F. Common forms include Verse-chorus with a spoken comedy break; Dance instructions as lyrics. Players should master character voices first, then sound effects as instruments (spike jones). Silly songs, simple chords.
